name: Sprott Physical Uranium Trust
blurb: Sprott Physical Uranium Trust is a closed-end trust that invests in physical uranium, providing investors with exposure to the uranium spot price. It holds uranium oxide (U3O8) in storage and aims to offer a convenient way to invest in the nuclear fuel market. The trust is managed by Sprott Asset Management LP and is one of the largest publicly traded vehicles for uranium investment.
recent: Over the past 30 days, SRUUF traded in a range of $20.05–$20.71, with a 52-week high of $24.77 set in January 2026. Recent news highlights include options strategies tied to nuclear energy demand amid geopolitical tensions and the critical-minerals push for AI. The stock has shown moderate volatility with a beta not disclosed.
